tools.name: search_insurance_facts
tools.description: Search already-publishable French home-insurance documentary facts with explicit domain synonyms (theft/burglary, leak detection, pipe repairs, etc.). All remaining meaningful terms must match; interpretation is returned and an ambiguous plumber/leak question asks for clarification. Start with query

tools.name: compare_public_insurance_formulas
tools.description: Compare two or three exact public home-insurance formulas on the same documentary criteria, with conditions, limits, deductibles and source citations. Start with no arguments to discover available formula_ids and coverage_ids. IDs include the document version. Missing cells never inherit product-lev

tools.name: get_insurance_fact
tools.description: Retrieve one already-publishable documentary fact using an exact fact_id returned by search_insurance_facts. Preserves formula, edition, conditions, uncertainty and source citations. Not found means unavailable in the public corpus, never an exclusion. Cannot access private or unpublished facts.

tools.name: get_habitation_leak_search
tools.description: Public, read-only documentary example: search for leaks versus repair of the pipe in home-insurance archival documents. Returns only previously publishable fact IDs with formula scope, document version and evidence IDs, or abstains. It never confirms current availability, personalized coverage, rank

tools.name: get_ai_sources
tools.description: Returns the AssurancesLabs citation-oriented sources map (same payload as GET /api/ai/sources).

tools.name: get_quote_requirements
tools.description: Discover questionnaire fields, conditional rules, accepted values and the internal AssurancesLabs recipient for native LLM intake across insurance types (MRH, PNO, auto, moto, santé, emprunteur, professional, animaux, etc.). No lead creation and no partner handoff.

tools.name: prepare_quote_request
tools.description: Validate a quote draft against the native questionnaire and return missing/invalid questions and the canonical consent prompt. Before asking the user again, inspect any prior explicit instruction in the SAME conversation and supply its EXACT verbatim text as prior_user_message. The server indicates

tools.name: render_pet_quote_consent
tools.description: Use this AFTER prepare_quote_request returns ready_to_submit=true for a pet insurance quote. Display the review and exact consent question in an interactive card inside ChatGPT, without opening AssurancesLabs. The user can explicitly accept or refuse. This tool only renders UI, it never creates a le

tools.name: render_quote_consent
tools.description: After prepare_quote_request returns ready_to_submit=true for any supported insurance type (MRH, auto, health, loan, professional, etc.), render an interactive consent review within ChatGPT, without Acheel/Assurland redirects. Read-only: it never writes or delivers a lead. The user reviews and answer

tools.name: resolve_quote_intent
tools.description: Maps an insurance type to the canonical questionnaire deep link and required fields (same as POST /api/ai/quote-intent).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "render_quote_consent" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_insurance_facts, render_quote_consent · Private data: search_insurance_facts, compare_public_insurance_formulas, get_insurance_fact, get_habitation_leak_search, render_pet_quote_consent · Public sink: resolve_quote_intent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_insurance_facts, render_quote_consent · Private data: search_insurance_facts, compare_public_insurance_formulas, get_insurance_fact, get_habitation_leak_search, render_pet_quote_consent · Public sink: resolve_quote_intent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
